steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Did you come all the way out to the boonies to dig up something good for me?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: For death and destruction, naturally.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Keep running your mouth. Though, as long as I'm on the giving side of death and destruction, I'm alright.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Almost here. Do you still remember anything about this place, Ratatos?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: ...If memory serves me right, this road leading out of Kjerag has long been abandoned since the wind and snow took down the bridge.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Blizzards are frequent, and even reinforced bridges are hard to secure. The people have all but given up on redeveloping the roads here.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: How many hands do you have at the Turicum pass?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enough to let me know who and what Enciodes deals with every day.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Then, do you know how much military equipment and personnel have passed into Kjerag under your nose lately?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Are you saying that Enciodes bypassed Turicum and opened a railway out in a place like this?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: ...That's ludicrous.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Look, it's coming.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: But that road leads straight down into a canyon...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Not anymore.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Impossible!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Tools were used to enclose the bridges, tracks, and load-bearing structures into the cliffs on both sides.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: To avoid prying eyes and ears, the structure extends from the mountain to form a bridge only when a train is about to pass...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Such a simple idea, yet incredibly intricate to implement. A pity that I didn't come up with it.
The fresh snow on the ground shudders imperceptibly, and a faint sound gradually grows stronger.
The bridge's bearings spring to life with sparks of light, just as the light of civilization shines into Kjerag.
The head of the train gallops over the bridge, segment after segment following behind it. Flames begin to dance, as if awakened by the weight of the train.
The youth turns to face the crowd and snaps his fingers.
The burning light suddenly expands, becoming brighter and warmer, engulfing several carriages in the middle of the train like a bonfire on a festival night.
Finally, unable to swallow what it had engulfed, the flames brutally split the carriage with a deafening roar.
Scintillating metallic objects splash forth like fireworks, clinking and clattering against the tenacious and resilient steel bars of the bridge before plummeting straight down.
A fur shawl dances in the flames' wake, but the sophisticated tactical suit seems indifferent.
Not a soul knows if all this happened too quickly, or if the spectacle simply paralyzed the senses. Everyone who witnessed the scene unfolding can only stare blankly, and wordlessly for a while.
Only the young man flourishes his Arts Unit nonchalantly, the snow rippling around him in waves.
He activates his Arts, letting a dazzling standard-issue military sabre gently slide down next to his feet. With but a gesture of his hand, the weapon is already in his grasp.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Victorian craftsmanship.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's quite sharp.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This vague, wispy blue texture... I wonder if you've ever seen any similar metals in SilverAsh's quarries?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Let's get to the point. You want to get information about Enciodes from me, and I want to use the Browntails' power against him.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As I said from the very beginning, I am not the only one here who needs to demonstrate good will. I am, after all, too familiar with how the Browntail clan does things.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Should you find yourselves at a disadvantage, or even realize you cannot deal with Enciodes at all, you'll capture me right away in an attempt to curry favor with him.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But time is short. Even I cannot estimate how many people Enciodes plans to bring in, or how many weapons.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I need to act now and destroy his transport route before he has enough power to bring everything under the sun into Kjerag.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: And beyond that, I need to cut off your retreat, as you all are now my accomplices.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Even if you choose to surrender to Enciodes, you are all inextricably tied to today's explosion.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: After I seal off this path, Enciodes may well lack the manpower to fight Arctosz head-on.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Now, you no longer have a choice.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Come, arrest Gnosis!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Easy now!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Ratatos, I take it that this is your answer?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: No, Gnosis, you got one of your premises wrong.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: From the very beginning, I never trusted you. I'd never fall in that easily with a traitor.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I've always wondered how you were always walking around all high-and-mighty, even after getting kicked out of Karlan Trade.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I always believed that Enciodes let you go because the information you have means nothing to him, and he expected you to backstab him.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I assumed he was using you as an unwitting smoke bomb to mess with us, but that's no longer the case.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: How could he allow you to go around doing whatever you want, disclosing secrets like these? How could such a crucial route not be guarded by any garrisoned troops?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're right, we're talking about Enciodes here. He'd never let his guard down.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Don't be so hasty. After all, their original mission was to cover up the traces left in the snow by the train.
Don't get too ahead of yourself, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Allow me to introduce you to the squad Enciodes has been training in secret, codenamed 'Tschäggättä.'

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You, what did you say?! ...Tschäggättä?!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They shall be as the Tschäggättä of ancient legend, not baptized in the glory of Kjeragandr, challenging superstition with pure strength.
The Tschäggättä of legend that hide in the depths of the highlands' snow-capped mountains.
The wear disconcerting masks, tie huge bells to their bodies, and wrap animal pelts around them. Kjerag children cry at the mention of their name.
But they are nothing more than legends.
The outfits worn by the troops in front of her bears little resemblance to the equipment scattered from the train. Seeing the masks on their faces, Ratatos cannot help but shiver.

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: The tolerance that the Master afforded you was graciously repaid with betrayal.

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: Round them up!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Ratatos, it is your turn to show your loyalty.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Grr... I'll remember this!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: There is about to be an accidental avalanche caused by a lightning strike.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The subordinates secretly dispatched here by Enciodes are, unfortunately, about to disappear.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The name of the squad was something like 'Tschäggättä.' There weren't many present, but seem to have all been taken alive by Ratatos.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The other two 'Tschäggättä' in charge of the freight train survived, but were also locked up.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: That's the extent of what I saw. I'm confident I wasn't seen.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Enciodes certainly would not see this as a simple natural disaster either.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, over here!

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: To avoid drawing the Silverash clan's suspicions, I will back out for now and await the Doctor's further instructions.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Heeey, I'm glad to see you're still kickin', Doctor! Sheesh, they told me I wouldn't be able to see you because you'd be tied up with official business or something.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I was real worried that you'd be stuck with the Paleroches until the ceremony was over.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, how come you're not talking? Are you okay?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Don't tell me the Paleroches did something to you!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: It hasn't even been that long...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I guess so much stuff has happened since you were invited here that it really does seem like a long time has passed.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh, but I heard that you're getting along well with Mr. Arctosz?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Eh... Not sure why that would surprise me though. After all, you're really popular around Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh right, is there anything I can help you with, Doctor? I feel bad that it's been one thing after another since you came here, so I was thinking I could maybe run some errands for you.

options: Can you help me protect Mr. Enciodes?
Can you say hello to the Saintess for me?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Huh? But with Degenbrecher there, why would my brother need me mucking things up?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But if that's what you want, I'll keep an eye on him.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: My sister's been awfully busy lately. Even I haven't had a chance to see her.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But if you really need me to, I can climb up the mountain and pay a secret visit.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Ugh, I just wanted to help you out, but I just made you worry even more about me...

options: Hmm, can you tell me some Kjerag folk tales then? Like, about the Tschäggättä?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Woah, where'd you hear that word?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Well... It's actually an old legend that goes way back.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Thousands of years ago, when Kjeragandr was protecting Her people from the wind and snow, a group of mountain savages rejected Her blessings. Among them––

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: We've confirmed that several segments of track suffered similar damage. The losses have been tabulated, and repairing them will take some time.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: But more critically, of the points of access between Kjerag and the outside world, several of the routes that were completely under our control have been cut off.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In other words, outside forces will no longer be able to enter Kjerag without great effort.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: But we still have a relative abundance of various supplies and materials in our reserves, enough to hold out while the tracks are being repaired...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's not the important part.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Additionally, we've confirmed that Gnosis and Ratatos have been in contact and have been lingering around our borders.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And what of the Doctor?

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: The Paleroche clan is no longer keeping a close watch on the Doctor. The guards are so discreet that we're unable to track them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Very well. You may go now.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Well done.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I must admit, this came as a bit of a surprise, but Gnosis indeed has the capacity to pull off something like this.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Your idea of trust is rather twisted.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He bore the burdens of Karlan Trade for so many years, so it's only natural that he would have the ability to exceed my expectations in certain areas.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is not trust, but rather a base requirement. A requirement that the Silverash clan has of its associates.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I always thought I would have the right to shoulder Kjeragandr's burden only when I was prepared to shoulder all of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It has been too long since the Tri-Clan Council and the Vine-Bead Court left this burden.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Don't tell me that's why you and the Saintess have to shoulder all of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: She may eventually come to make the same choice.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And I need to prepare for the next step.
